system.description:
Cylindrical dwarven warhammer marked with Grabthar's rune (eye within a diamond). Normally functions as a Warhammer +1 (1d6+1).

Paired with Grabthar's Gauntlets of Power: Runes glow pale blue; base damage increases to 1d10 and enchantment rises to +2 to hit / +3 damage (stacking with the Gauntlets for +5 to hit / +10 damage). May also be thrown up to 60' and returns to the wielder's hand in the same round.
